title: ieee80211: Add address type for RA and TA
description:
Add an address type for the RA and TA addresses in IEEE 802.11,
and use it in Control frames (and Extension frames, and PV1)
where we currently just set the COL_RES_DL_[SRC|DST] column
text.

Setting the text only works where the underlying pinfo->dl_dst
is AT_NONE, because otherwise col_set_addr at the end of dissection
will overwrite the column with the value obtained from the address
in pinfo->dl_dst. That's generally for cases where IEEE 802.11
is the first link-layer type encountered that may set the address.

This makes the column text be appropriate even in cases where
WLAN is tunneled, such as the Aruba ERM format over UDP.

This loses having the "resolved" column version having ("RA") or
similar in parenthesis (due to how the address to string functions
must return static strings), but works for the unresolved column,
and also allows right-clicking to generate a filter to work properly.

Do something similar for the AID in PV1 when we only have that.

Fix #17466
